category: other: no retreat after the button press - pressed the start button, then kept rubbing the top of the machine until timeout
what_happened: Scene: layout 9, brown machine with two small round buttons on its front-right face, red mug_5 on an open upper shelf. Stage 0: fingers closed at 124 and the mug was taken out of the shelf from 140 (rim grasp), carried down and set on the drip tray under the spout; released 371 at 0.0205 m from the pour site (0.0285 m 2 s later), upright. That is a good placement. Stage 1: the gripper went to the front buttons (412-448) and the lower button registered at 443 (turned_on from 443 to the end). It did not back off: 480-650 it stayed at the front/upper body of the machine, and from ~664 to 1200 it lay on the machine's lid, rubbing it (machine contact 686-767, 769-987, 1016-1200). Stage 0's release clause held only 663-688, while the arm was momentarily > 25 cm from the mug; stage 1 (success) never held because the gripper was never > 15 cm from the button and > 25 cm from the mug at the same time.
causal_chain: mug placed 0.02 m from the pour site (371) -> button pressed, machine on (443) -> gripper never withdraws: works on the machine top 664-1200 -> success needs gripper > 0.15 m from button and > 0.25 m from mug -> timeout at 1200 with mug placed and machine on
self_recovery: none needed for the placement. After the press the policy behaves as if the button were still to be found (moves over the machine top), and never retreats.
official_criterion_notes: Physically both sub-goals were achieved by 443 (mug under the spout, machine on). The failure is only the 'gripper away' clause. The packet's first_incomplete_stage = 0 is an artifact of the 25 cm release clause (gripper back near the mug), not a real undo (undone_events: 'only the release part broke').
